---

We need to determine the time required to read **15 pages** at a **rate of 1/4 of a page per day**.

$$
\text{Time in days} = \frac{15 \text{ pages}}{1/4 \text{ pages/day}} = 60 \text{ days}
$$

---

Since the reading rate is given per month, we now convert 60 days to months.

Assuming **30 days per month** (standard interpretation), we get:

$$
\text{Months} = \frac{60 \text{ days}}{30 \text{ days/month}} = 2 \text{ months}
$$

$$

$$
\text{Rate of gain} = \frac{1 \text{ minute}}{64 \text{ seconds}} = \frac{1}{64} \text{ minutes per second}
$$

$$

$$

$$

$$
